rightsReview.reason: Independent through-operators Tokyu, Tokyo Metro and Yokohama Minatomirai Railway reserve copyrighted timetables, diagrams and prose. Retain only independently structured minimum static factual local-stop pattern, attribution, URL/date and fingerprints; no raw artwork, timetable clocks or compiled pages. Tokyu March 2026 timetable currently marks northbound Shinrin-koen departures with the Tobu-local code. Metro historical diagram supplies the explicitly named ordinary all-station rule, corroborated against the current partner station order and current service-class legend; its obsolete claim that all through services are local is expressly excluded. Municipal alternative returned actual 404 and is not evidence. The commercial-restricted Tobu website is not an extraction source.
